usedFor: Hostfully holds vacation rental bookings, and Documint produces documents when “New Booking” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Hostfully, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking fills a Documint template with its details, so paperwork starts the moment a guest books.

watchOut: “Cancelled Booking” and “Updated Booking” are separate triggers, so each needs its own template wording.
